g.title: thyroid_storm
g.text: THYROID STORM — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map
갑상선 폭풍 · 갑상선 중독 위기 (thyrotoxic crisis)
Storm = the closure of three positive-feedback rings (A, B, C) — not a higher hormone level.
Serum T4/T3 do not separate storm from uncomplicated thyrotoxicosis. The loop gain L does: L < 1 = severe thyrotoxicosis, L ≥ 1 = storm.
Drugs that change the INPUT act over weeks (the gland holds a 2-month reservoir). Drugs that change the GAIN act in hours. β-blockade acts on the gain twice.

g.title: cluster_precip
g.text: identifiable in 70–90% of storms · worth 10 BWPS points on its own · this is what a hormone assay cannot see

g.title: cluster_hpt
g.text: the feedback loop that is already fully open (TSH < 0.01) before the storm begins — it has no reserve left to help

g.title: cluster_iodide
g.text: 3. IODIDE — the one drug whose SIGN depends on the order of administration
release block (the acute benefit) vs organification SUBSTRATE (Jod-Basedow, the harm) · escape by NIS down-regulation at 10–14 days

g.title: cluster_gland
g.text: 2. GLAND — the input machinery, and a 2-MONTH RESERVOIR
Graves ≈ 60–80% of storms · toxic adenoma / MNG · thyroiditis · TSHoma · struma ovarii · metastatic follicular carcinoma

g.title: cluster_effector
g.text: 8. HEAT-LOSS EFFECTOR — the high-gain regulator that normally wins
h can rise 7-fold (8 → 60 W/K). Storm happens when this effector is CRIPPLED (ring C, hypovolaemia), not merely outrun.

g.title: cluster_bind
g.text: 4. THE BOUND RESERVOIR — 99.7% of T3 is invisible to the tissues
the SECOND AXIS: doubling the free FRACTION is arithmetically identical to doubling the total hormone — and only one of the two is measured

g.title: cluster_deiod
g.text: 5. PERIPHERAL DEIODINATION — 80% of circulating T3 is made OUTSIDE the thyroid
this is the FAST axis (T3 t½ = 24 h) that PTU, glucocorticoid, iopanoic acid and propranolol attack. Methimazole does not touch it.

g.title: cluster_tr
g.text: saturating: TR occupancy is ALREADY ~50% at normal fT3, so the tissue response is never proportional to the assay result

g.title: cluster_ringB
g.text: every +10 °C doubles metabolic rate (Q10 = 2), and metabolism is precisely what heats the core

g.title: cluster_ringA
g.text: fT3 → β1 density & lipolytic machinery → NEFA → displacement from TBG → free fraction → fT3.
Its gain is proportional to the β-signal, which is why β-blockade cuts it.

g.title: cluster_sns
g.text: 7. ADRENERGIC LIMB — sensitisation, not more transmitter
plasma catecholamines are NORMAL or LOW in thyrotoxicosis; the β-signal rises because RECEPTOR DENSITY rises. The model therefore has no T3 → catecholamine arrow.

g.title: cluster_ringC
g.text: why storm hyperthermia becomes irreversible: the thermostat is itself heat-labile

g.title: cluster_cv
g.text: 9. CARDIOVASCULAR — high-output failure, and the β-blockade trap
HR ≥ 140 in storm · AF in 10–35% · CHF in ~25% · β-blocking a rate-dependent heart can precipitate cardiogenic shock

g.title: cluster_liver
g.text: 10. HEPATIC & GI — jaundice is the single worst prognostic sign
bilirubin > 3 mg/dL = 20 BWPS points and an independent mortality predictor · vomiting/diarrhoea make the ORAL ROUTE fail

g.title: cluster_hpa
g.text: 11. HPA AXIS — thyroid hormone creates its own steroid deficit
cortisol clearance is roughly DOUBLED by T3 at the same moment the stress requirement rises: a scissor, not a coincidence

g.title: cluster_nm
g.text: thyrotoxic periodic paralysis is strongly Asian-male-predominant (KCNJ18) and is a hypokalaemic emergency in its own right

g.title: cluster_thio
g.text: D1. THIONAMIDES — they change the INPUT, and the input feeds a 2-MONTH RESERVOIR
PTU is preferred in storm for exactly ONE reason: it ALSO inhibits D1, i.e. it also attacks the fast axis. Nothing else distinguishes it.

g.title: cluster_beta
g.text: D2. β-BLOCKADE — the GAIN drug. It acts on ring A TWICE.
(1) it removes the β term from heart rate and from the thermogenic term; (2) it removes the β term from LIPOLYSIS,
so the FREE FRACTION falls without a single molecule of hormone being removed.

g.title: cluster_other
g.text: D3. THE REST — sorted by WHICH FACTOR OF THE MODEL THEY MULTIPLY
iodide / glucocorticoid / iopanoic acid / cholestyramine change the INPUT · cooling and fluids change the GAIN of rings B and C · plasma exchange is the only lever on the BOUND reservoir

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: BWPS ≥ 45 = storm · Japan Thyroid Association criteria · mortality 8–25% treated, 80–90% untreated

g.title: S_store
g.text: (falls to ~2–5 days in florid untreated Graves)

g.title: SNS
g.text: set by the PRECIPITANT, not by T3

g.title: PGE2
g.text: present ONLY if the precipitant is infectious

g.title: rT3
g.text: ↑↑ = proof that a D1 block is working

g.title: PROP
g.text: 60–80 mg q4h PO, or 0.5–1 mg IV boluses
NON-SELECTIVE (blocks β2 lipolysis too) · t½ 4 h

g.title: SSKI
g.text: SSKI 250 mg iodide q6h / Lugol 8 drops q8h

g.title: COOL
g.text: cooling blanket · cold IV fluid · ice packs

g.title: COOL->hcond
g.text: = cuts the gain of rings B and C

g.title: LEG
g.text: positive-feedback ring (A, B, C) — the GAIN of the disease
hormone pools, protein binding, free fraction
nuclear receptor signalling and its target genes
